blocks.x: Then here’s another Quincy, Basie and Beyond, but you’re in the section.
We also did Juke Joint, which . . .
Yep, that’s true. Unfortunately, it didn’t show up in your discography, but I know Juke Joint. It’s got Stomp.
Yeah, I got – that’s that dedication. You see that top? It was Juke Joint. He wrote me a letter, a note, and sent it here.
Yes, Carol [Dubach?], my friend, tennis player.
Then here’s Eugene Maslav. You mentioned . . .
Oh my God, that guy is tremendous. That’s the guy I told you, Russian.
Remember I told you about the Russian?
Oh yeah. So I just wanted to make sure we referenced it for the record here.
